rationale: C20 is an unmistakable direct drafting template. The child reproduces its entire two-section structure and nearly all of its operative language, changing principally the cited appropriation from the 1954 supplemental appropriation to the 1955 independent-offices appropriation and adding coverage of any reenactment. C09 and C11 contain related delegation, reporting, and direction-and-control formulations, but neither approaches C20's nearly verbatim correspondence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget is hereby authorized and empowered to exercise the authority vested in the President by the paragraph appearing under the heading "Expenses of Management Improvement" in Title I of the Independent Offices Appropriation Act, 1955 ... to allocate to any agency or office of the executive branch (including the Bureau of the Budget) funds appropriated by the said paragraph
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget is hereby authorized and empowered to exercise the authority vested in the President by the paragraph appearing under the heading "Funds Appropriated to the President—Expenses of Management Improvement" in Chapter VII of the Supplemental Appropriation Act, 1954, to allocate to any agency or office in the executive branch (including the Bureau of the Budget) funds appropriated by the said paragraph.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely copies C20's statutory delegation and fund-allocation provision while updating the appropriation citation and adding reenactment language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget shall from time to time report to the President concerning activities carried on by executive agencies and offices with funds allocated hereunder and shall, consonant with law, exercise such direction and control with respect to the said activities as he shall deem appropriate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget shall from time to time report to the President concerning activities carried on by executive agencies and offices with funds allocated hereunder and shall, consonant with law, exercise such direction and control with respect to the said activities as he shall deem appropriate.
shared_material.explanation: Section 2 is reproduced verbatim, supplying distinctive reporting and supervisory machinery.
